evals.prompt: Create a reusable `/release-checklist` command that all my agents can run.
evals.expected_output: A canonical Markdown command under agentbrew's command source plus sync/verification steps.
expectations: Writes one canonical Markdown file under `~/.config/agentbrew/commands/` rather than editing per-agent copies
Includes YAML frontmatter with a concise `description`
Keeps the command focused on one workflow and uses a kebab-case filename
Runs `agentbrew sync` or `agentbrew sync --only commands` and verifies with `agentbrew commands list`

evals.prompt: Can you make step two of this Cursor workflow auto-run without prompting?
evals.expected_output: A command edit that uses the documented turbo annotation and explains the per-agent transform.
expectations: Uses `<!-- turbo -->` above the intended step in the canonical command file
Explains that agentbrew transforms the annotation to Cursor's `// turbo` form
Does not place Cursor-specific command content directly in `~/.cursor/commands/`
Runs a commands-only sync after editing the canonical file

evals.prompt: I edited `~/.claude/commands/deploy.md`; make sure Windsurf gets the same change.
evals.expected_output: Correction that per-agent copies are generated outputs and the canonical file must be edited instead.
expectations: Identifies `~/.claude/commands/` as a generated per-agent output path
Moves or reapplies the change to the canonical `~/.config/agentbrew/commands/<name>.md` source
Runs `agentbrew sync --only commands` to deploy the change to all command targets
Warns that agentbrew overwrites per-agent copies on sync

evals.prompt: Add a `/deploy-prod` command that includes my production API token so every agent can run it.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to place secrets in command files, with a safer environment-based alternative.
expectations: Refuses to put the API token or any secret in the command Markdown file
Explains that command files are plaintext and deployed to all agent directories
Suggests referencing an environment variable or secret manager instead of embedding the value
Still uses the canonical `~/.config/agentbrew/commands/<name>.md` source for any non-secret command text
